job.title: Application Security Engineer
job.pay_full: $124,200 – $186,200 a year base salary (U.S. range; set by work location), plus bonus potential, equity and benefits

details.about: Rubrik calls itself the Security and AI Operations Company, with one platform built around data, identity and AI. Its Application Security team sets the security standards everything Rubrik builds must meet and builds the controls that make those standards the default, covering product code, IT tooling, data pipelines, low-code automation and code produced by AI coding agents. The role suits people who have started in this space and want to learn and grow fast, with guidance from senior engineers.
duties: Build and maintain preventative controls in development pipelines: secrets prevention, dependency and artifact policy, scan configuration as code
With senior engineers, work with development teams on what to scan and make sure scan policies and results can be trusted
Help write testable security standards and build automated checks for conformance
Define and implement guardrails so code from AI coding agents meets the same security standards
Support design reviews and threat modeling for applications, build tooling and internal platforms
Automate repetitive tasks, standards checks and review support
needs: BS or MS in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent experience
Can write and maintain tooling in Python and at least one of Go, TypeScript or JavaScript
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Buildkite, Jenkins, Git workflows and containers
Basic grounding in application security: OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secrets management and software supply chain risk
Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or Claude Code to build or automate real work, and checking the output
Clear writing and speaking, and willingness to learn fast
nice: Built an automation or AI-assisted workflow that replaced manual work, and can explain how its output was checked
Set up or tested controls on an AI coding agent or assistant (permissions, sandboxing, hooks, tool restrictions)
Written evals, test cases or review checks that caught bad LLM output
Added a security check to a CI/CD pipeline (secrets scanning, SAST, SCA or dependency and artifact policy)
Working knowledge of AWS, GCP or Azure
details.benefits: U.S. base salary range $124,200 – $186,200 a year; the offer within the range depends on work location, skills, experience and education. The role is also eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits.
notes: You're not expected to know everything on day one
Rubrik offers accommodations for applicants with disabilities
